findings.title: Authorization check missing on administrative export
findings.evidence: Synthetic role matrix shows a standard lab user receiving HTTP 200 for an administrator-only export request.
findings.remediation: Enforce server-side authorization using centrally managed policy checks for every privileged object and action.
findings.validation: Repeat the synthetic role-matrix tests and confirm non-admin roles receive 403 while approved administrator access remains functional.

findings.title: Parameterized query control absent in legacy search path
findings.evidence: Static review of a deliberately insecure training fixture shows user input concatenated into a SQL statement rather than bound as a parameter.
findings.remediation: Replace string-built queries with parameterized statements and constrain database permissions to application-required operations.
findings.validation: Run unit and integration tests with benign metacharacter inputs and verify the database driver uses bound parameters without changing query structure.

findings.title: Security events lack actor and request correlation fields
findings.evidence: Synthetic audit records omit actor_id and request_id, preventing deterministic correlation across denied and successful events.
findings.remediation: Emit structured security events containing actor, request correlation, action, resource, outcome, source context, and UTC timestamp.
findings.validation: Generate authorized lab events and confirm required fields are present, queryable, time-normalized, and retained by the test collector.

findings.title: Outbound fetch policy permits unapproved destination classes
findings.evidence: Synthetic policy evaluation accepts a reserved-address destination that is outside the approved lab destination allowlist.
findings.remediation: Use canonical destination allowlists, reject private/reserved address classes unless explicitly required, and enforce egress controls independently of application validation.
findings.validation: Exercise the offline destination-policy test matrix and verify disallowed address classes fail closed while approved fixtures continue to resolve.

findings.title: Session cookie hardening validated after remediation
findings.evidence: Synthetic retest confirms Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite controls are set and session rotation occurs after authentication.
findings.remediation: Retain secure cookie defaults and regression tests in the authentication middleware pipeline.
findings.validation: Continue automated regression checks for cookie attributes and session rotation on every authentication-related change.
